name: 45506 · Springfield, OH
findings: ZIP 45506 (Springfield) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45506 (Springfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45506 (Springfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
